facilities.name: Ovi Raishiin visitor point
facilities.description: Official Reisa National Park visitor point and main valley gateway with information, maps/posters, roofed seating, viewpoint, tables, benches, campfire sites, toilets and nearby Nordkalottstua lodging.

facilities.name: Ovi Raishiin parking
facilities.description: Surface parking at Ovi Raishiin. Winter or wet-ground parking may be at Saraelv with a short forest-road walk.

facilities.name: Nordkalottstua - Ovi Raishiin
facilities.description: Bookable/unserviced 3-4 or 4-person cabin at Ovi Raishiin. Current Reisa sources indicate booking/keybox/code or contact is required; do not model as a normal always-open DNT-key hut. Facilities include wood stove, gas cooking, no power/running water in cabin, nearby toilet, summer water post/tap and outdoor waste bins.
facilities.routeProximity: start/access cluster; about 140-160 m from OSM/E1 route line

facilities.name: Sieimmastua
facilities.description: Reservable west-bank rental cabin at Sieimma, built in 2016 and owned by the Reisa National Park Board. Facilities include 3-4 beds, wood stove, gas stove, outdoor toilet, water from stream/Reisaelva, no power, no mobile coverage, pets allowed with rules, and waste pack-out.

facilities.name: Sieimmahytta / Sieimahytta
facilities.description: Open/free Statskog cabin on the east side of Reisaelva, opposite Nordkalott Trail and Sieimmastua. Sources agree on open hut and boat crossing, but capacity and equipment differ: Statskog/UT list 4 beds, wood heating/cooking and outdoor toilet; Reisa says 4-6 people and adds gas stove/kitchen equipment.
facilities.routeProximity: about 55-90 m from west-bank endpoint, across Reisaelva by rowboat
